messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired — service=gpu-serving, severity=critical, alert=cuda_alloc_failure; pool=gpu-pool-3; region=us-west-2; link=https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345

Maria V: acked via PagerDuty :white_check_mark:

Alex K: jumping on it — looking at node list

John S: oncall? I'm 2nd, stand by to escalate

Maria V: observed spike in `cuda_alloc` on host gpu-03-12, logs show repeated 'out of memory' during kvcache allocate

Alex K: checking `dmesg` and driver logs

Alex K: ```
[2026-03-14T03:21:12Z] cuda: alloc failed: size=238MB, error=CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-14T03:21:13Z] kvcache: evict start
[2026-03-14T03:21:14Z] cuda: kernel panic? reclaim failed
```

Maria V: traffic pattern shows short tail requests + long context chats — batching spike

Alex K: rolling a soft-evict on pool gpu-pool-3: `redwoodctl pool evict --pool gpu-pool-3 --percent 30` — will monitor

incident-bot: autoscaler: detected evictions, capacity decreased by 1 node

John S: If evict doesn't hold, I'll escalate to infra to drain node and force restart driver

Maria V: alerting SRE infra via @pagerduty, tagging `infra-oncall`

Alex K: Mitigation: temporarily enable `kv_cache_age_limit=30s` for that pool to reduce memory 👇

Alex K: ```bash
redwoodctl config set gpu-pool-3 kv_cache_age_limit=30s --apply
```

Maria V: applied — seeing backend token latency up but fewer OOMs

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation: infra-oncall paged (John S) — 03:35 UTC

John S: acked, joining. Running `nvidia-smi` shows 95% mem used on gpu-03-12

John S: running `sudo systemctl restart redwood-gpu-driver` on gpu-03-12 to clear leaked allocations

Alex K: heads-up: some customer requests failed (approx 1.2% of requests in last 15m) — marking incident impact: degraded throughput for hosted API

Maria V: opened incident in GH: redwood/ops-incidents#378 with root cause field blank, will update

John S: driver restart completed, services recovering, kvcache evictions dropping

Alex K: confirming model-serving latency back to normal on that host

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged and resolved (auto-close pending) — 04:02 UTC

Maria V: moving to handoff — I'm out at 04:30 UTC, John will take primary for follow-ups

John S: will own follow-ups, will run overnight checks and schedule postmortem draft tomorrow

Maria V: notes for postmortem: suspected KV cache leak + aggressive batching; suggested next steps: add memory watermark alert per-GPU, reduce default kvcache_age_limit for new deployments, add smoke test for long-context workloads

Alex K: assigned follow-ups in GH tasks

Maria V: thanks all — :thumbsup:

John S: leaving final note: incident severity P2 (customer-facing, short-lived degradation). Closing thread.
